# Game Idea: Asteroid Escape

**Concept**: The player pilots a small spaceship on an HTML canvas, moving left/right to dodge incoming asteroids that scroll down at increasing speed.

**Lose Condition**: Collision with any asteroid ends the game.

**Core Mechanics**: Simple arrow‑key controls, continuous asteroid spawning, score based on survival time. The game can be built with basic canvas drawing and collision detection.

1: // Asteroid Escape – enhanced graphics
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: const WIDTH = canvas.width;
5: const HEIGHT = canvas.height;
6: 
7: // ----- Starfield background -----
8: const stars = [];
9: for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
10:   stars.push({
11:     x: Math.random() * WIDTH,
12:     y: Math.random() * HEIGHT,
13:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
14:   });
15: }
16: function drawStars() {
17:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
18:   stars.forEach(s => {
19:     ctx.beginPath();
20:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
21:     ctx.fill();
22:   });
23: }
24: 
25: // ----- Player ship -----
26: const ship = {
27:   width: 30,
28:   height: 30,
29:   x: WIDTH / 2 - 15,
30:   y: HEIGHT - 40,
31:   speed: 5,
32:   moveLeft: false,
33:   moveRight: false,
34:   draw() {
35:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
36:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#00ff00');
37:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#006600');
38:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
39:     ctx.beginPath();
40:     ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.height);
41:     ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y);
42:     ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
43:     ctx.closePath();
44:     ctx.fill();
45:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#003300';
46:     ctx.stroke();
47:   },
48:   update() {
49:     if (this.moveLeft) this.x = Math.max(0, this.x - this.speed);
50:     if (this.moveRight) this.x = Math.min(WIDTH - this.width, this.x + this.speed);
51:   }
52: };
53: 
54: // ----- Asteroids -----
55: const asteroids = [];
56: let asteroidTimer = 0;
57: const spawnInterval = 90; // frames
58: let gameOver = false;
59: let startTime = null;
60: let score = 0;
61: 
62: function spawnAsteroid() {
63:   const radius = Math.random() * 15 + 10;
64:   const x = Math.random() * (WIDTH - radius * 2) + radius;
65:   const speed = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
66:   const hue = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) + 200; // bluish gray
67:   const asteroid = { x, y: -radius, radius, speed, hue };
68:   asteroids.push(asteroid);
69: }
70: 
71: function drawAsteroids() {
72:   asteroids.forEach(a => {
73:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
74:     grad.addColorStop(0, `hsl(${a.hue}, 20%, 60%)`);
75:     grad.addColorStop(1, `hsl(${a.hue}, 10%, 30%)`);
76:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
77:     ctx.beginPath();
78:     ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
79:     ctx.fill();
80:   });
81: }
82: 
83: function updateAsteroids() {
84:   for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
85:     const a = asteroids[i];
86:     a.y += a.speed;
87:     if (a.y - a.radius > HEIGHT) {
88:       asteroids.splice(i, 1);
89:     } else if (checkCollision(a)) {
90:       gameOver = true;
91:     }
92:   }
93: }
94: 
95: function checkCollision(a) {
96:   const cx = ship.x + ship.width / 2;
97:   const cy = ship.y + ship.height / 2;
98:   const dx = Math.abs(a.x - cx);
99:   const dy = Math.abs(a.y - cy);
100:   if (dx > (ship.width / 2 + a.radius)) return false;
101:   if (dy > (ship.height / 2 + a.radius)) return false;
102:   return true;
103: }
104: 
105: function drawScore() {
106:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
107:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
108:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}` , 10, 20);
109: }
110: 
111: function drawGameOver() {
112:   ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,0,0,0.4)';
113:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
114:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
115:   ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
116:   ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2 - 80, HEIGHT / 2);
117:   drawScore();
118: }
119: 
120: function loop(timestamp) {
121:   if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
122:   const delta = timestamp - startTime;
123:   score = delta / 1000;
124: 
125:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
126:   drawStars();
127: 
128:   if (!gameOver) {
129:     if (asteroidTimer++ > spawnInterval) {
130:       spawnAsteroid();
131:       asteroidTimer = 0;
132:     }
133:     ship.update();
134:     updateAsteroids();
135:     ship.draw();
136:     drawAsteroids();
137:     drawScore();
138:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
139:   } else {
140:     drawGameOver();
141:   }
142: }
143: 
144: // Audio setup using Web Audio API
145: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
146: 
147: function playTone(freq, duration = 0.1, type = 'sine') {
148:   const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
149:   const gainNode = audioCtx.createGain();
150:   oscillator.type = type;
151:   oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
152:   gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
153:   oscillator.connect(gainNode).connect(audioCtx.destination);
154:   oscillator.start();
155:   oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
156: }
157: 
158: function playMoveSound() {
159:   // short higher pitch for move
160:   playTone(600, 0.05);
161: }
162: 
163: function playCollisionSound() {
164:   // lower pitch, longer for collision
165:   playTone(150, 0.3, 'square');
166: }
167: 
168: function playSpawnSound() {
169:   // subtle blip
170:   playTone(400, 0.07);
171: }
172: 
173: // ----- Input handling -----
174: let moveSoundPlayed = false;
175: 
176: document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
177:   if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
178:     ship.moveLeft = true;
179:     if (!moveSoundPlayed) { playMoveSound(); moveSoundPlayed = true; }
180:   }
181:   if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
182:     ship.moveRight = true;
183:     if (!moveSoundPlayed) { playMoveSound(); moveSoundPlayed = true; }
184:   }
185: });
186: 
187: document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
188:   if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
189:     ship.moveLeft = false;
190:     moveSoundPlayed = false;
191:   }
192:   if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
193:     ship.moveRight = false;
194:     moveSoundPlayed = false;
195:   }
196: });
197: 
198: // hook sound on asteroid spawn and collision
199: const originalSpawnAsteroid = spawnAsteroid;
200: spawnAsteroid = function() {
201:   playSpawnSound();
202:   originalSpawnAsteroid();
203: };
204: 
205: const originalCheckCollision = checkCollision;
206: function checkCollision(a) {
207:   const collided = originalCheckCollision(a);
208:   if (collided) {
209:     playCollisionSound();
210:   }
211:   return collided;
212: }
213: 
214: requestAnimationFrame(loop);

(End of file - total 214 lines)
</content>
